CBSE Class 12 Marks Dispute: Student and Board Disagree on Revaluation

A controversy has emerged regarding the re-evaluation of Class 12 student Vedant Shrivastava's marks, specifically for his Physics paper. While the student claims his Physics marks did not increase significantly after re-evaluation, the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has stated that the student's claims are a "blatant lie" and that his marks actually increased by 11. The situation has sparked debate over the accuracy and transparency of the re-evaluation process.
